functionDeclarations.name: find_supplier
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve the supplier named on the price file to its supplier id. (GET /api/v2/suppliers)

functionDeclarations.name: list_products
functionDeclarations.description: Bulk-fetch the current catalog for matching and diffing. Rows include sku, mpn, barcode, default_supplier_id, default_supplier_sku, default_supplier_price, unit_cost, and type. (GET /api/v2/products)

per_page.description: Page size (default 10; use 500 for a bulk pull).

filter[default_supplier_id].description: Limit to products whose default supplier matches (comma-separated ids).

filter[search].description: Full-text search across id, SKU, name, barcode, MPN, brand.

functionDeclarations.name: get_product_by_sku
functionDeclarations.description: Targeted existence check for a single row when a bulk pull is overkill. (GET /api/products/by-sku)

sku.description: The exact SKU to look up.

functionDeclarations.name: get_product_suppliers
functionDeclarations.description: Read a product's supplier links, including each link's supplier pricing tiers — this is where the account's actual tier name (e.g. "Wholesale") and current price come from. (GET /api/products/{productId}/suppliers)

functionDeclarations.name: update_product_pricing
functionDeclarations.description: Write the new prices. Cost side goes in suppliers[].pricing[] (tier name + price, with operation "updateOrCreate" on EVERY entry so omitted suppliers are not unlinked); sell side goes in pricing[] (product_pricing_tier_name + price). All fields optional. (PUT /api/products/{id})

pricing.description: Sell-price tiers, each { product_pricing_tier_name, price }. Only send when the task includes updating what you charge; a supplier cost file alone should not touch these.

suppliers.description: Supplier links, each { supplier_id, operation, pricing: [{ supplier_pricing_tier_name, price }] }. Set operation "updateOrCreate" on every entry — when any entry omits operation the array is treated as the complete list and absent suppliers are UNLINKED. Tier price is required, numeric, >= 0 and < 100000; price null returns 422.
